set -eu
cat > analysis.R <<'EOF'

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(splines))

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) != 2) {
  stop("expected input csv and output csv paths")
}
in_path <- args[1]
out_path <- args[2]

d <- read.csv(in_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
if (!all(c("StrainNumber", "Ratio", "Area") %in% names(d))) {
  stop("required columns not found")
}

d <- d[d$StrainNumber == "287_98", , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(d) != 36) {
  stop(sprintf("expected 36 mixture rows, found %d", nrow(d)))
}

parts <- strsplit(as.character(d$Ratio), ":", fixed = TRUE)
d$p <- vapply(parts, function(z) {
  a <- as.numeric(z[1])
  b <- as.numeric(z[2])
  a / (a + b)
}, numeric(1))

if (any(!is.finite(d$p)) || any(d$p <= 0) || any(d$p >= 1)) {
  stop("invalid interior mixture proportions")
}

fit_models <- list(
  quadratic = lm(Area ~ p + I(p^2), data = d),
  cubic = lm(Area ~ p + I(p^2) + I(p^3), data = d),
  natural_spline = lm(Area ~ ns(p, df = 4), data = d)
)

pred_at <- function(fit, x) {
  predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(p = x))
}

global_max <- function(fit, lower, upper) {
  grid <- seq(lower, upper, length.out = 5001)
  vals <- pred_at(fit, grid)
  i <- which.max(vals)

  left <- grid[max(1L, i - 2L)]
  right <- grid[min(length(grid), i + 2L)]
  local <- optimize(function(x) pred_at(fit, x), interval = c(left, right),
                    maximum = TRUE, tol = 1e-10)

  full <- optimize(function(x) pred_at(fit, x), interval = c(lower, upper),
                   maximum = TRUE, tol = 1e-10)

  if (full$objective >= local$objective) {
    full
  } else {
    local
  }
}

lower <- min(d$p)
upper <- max(d$p)
rows <- list()

for (nm in names(fit_models)) {
  fit <- fit_models[[nm]]
  opt <- global_max(fit, lower, upper)
  aic <- AIC(fit)
  bic <- BIC(fit)
  edf <- as.numeric(extractAIC(fit)[1])
  adj_r2 <- summary(fit)$adj.r.squared

  rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
    model = nm,
    edf = edf,
    n = nrow(d),
    aic = as.numeric(aic),
    bic = as.numeric(bic),
    adj_r2 = adj_r2,
    optimum_p = opt$maximum,
    max_area = opt$objective,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

summary_df <- do.call(rbind, rows)
write.csv(summary_df, file = out_path, row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
